svg.title: GitHub activity: 1,968 publicly displayed contributions
svg.desc: A three-dimensional GitHub activity calendar showing 1,968 publicly displayed contributions from 2025-10-05 through 2026-10-07. Bars use the pinned upstream github-profile-3d-contrib geometry and log-scaled daily counts; face color follows GitHub's contribution level. GitHub's public display may include privacy-obscured activity. No private repositories were accessed.
svg.text: Bar height: upstream log scale · color: GitHub level
